section_summary.extract_value: This is a 'Measures' section describing the assessment instruments used in a study. The study employed the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) to assess body appreciation and self-reported height and weight to calculate BMI. Additional measures included the Early Memories of Warmth and Safeness Scale (EMWSS), Self-Compassion Scale (SCS), and Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q), all with Portuguese versions available.
